pages.text: Boat lamps lit one by one. Bedtime! Mom brought water in a scoop, but Bung hid under the awning. "Not today! I am sleepy!"
"I will sleep quickly and wake first tomorrow!" Bung pulled up the blanket and shut both eyes. Little Ddori was already sleeping. Tied to its post, the boat was quiet.
Bung woke in the night. A tickle between the teeth! A tongue push found a dinner noodle stuck there. "Strange... It keeps tickling."
Mom brought a lantern, looked inside Bung's wide-open mouth, and nodded. "A noodle is sleeping between your teeth."
Mom put a little brush in Bung's hand and a cup of water from the big bucket nearby. "This brush will sweep it out."
Bung brushed up and down. Bubbles rose. Ddori woke to watch. Out slipped the noodle! "Brush those stuck noodles away!"
Bung swished a mouthful of water, then spat into Mom's empty scoop. A tongue check found smooth teeth.
The tickle was gone. Back under the blanket, Bung's eyes closed. Lamps out, the tied boat rocked gently.
Next morning, Bung took the brush first. "One, brush after dinner! Two, brush after waking! Three, carefully where noodles stick!" Bung brought Ddori's hand close and gave the little brush.
Mom sat Bung on her knee and patted the back. Brushing before sleep kept the nighttime tickle away. Bung showed Ddori those teeth. "Brush those stuck noodles away!"
